item: BRO1105/BRO1111 same_line at the line limit
notes: The joined line is measured as the other fixes leave it (BRO1404/BRO1007 modifier, BRO1109 `(`, BRO1108 split, BRO1110 `)`), so one run converges in any order. Renames and rewrites inside the line aren't counted (documented on both rule pages).
